purpose: Competing rescue hypothesis: a proteostasis-stabilizer probe restores missense abundance. Status labels are not interchangeable.

links.statement: Both synthetic alleles are present in the fixture call set.
links.supports: a two-allele research candidate in this fixture
links.does_not_support: orthogonal confirmation, germline origin, or phase

links.statement: Both synthetic alleles are orthogonally confirmed on a second aliquot with both strands counted.
links.supports: nothing until a confirmation record is filled from approved material
links.does_not_support: a child's confirmation or a medicine claim

links.statement: The stop-class synthetic allele is loss-of-function compatible on its annotated transcript.
links.does_not_support: measured transcript depletion in a person

links.statement: Trans configuration of the two synthetic alleles must be established from an approved phase record.
links.supports: nothing until a phase record is filled from approved data

links.statement: Stop-class RNA is depleted and missense RNA is expressed in the tested cells.
links.supports: nothing until a transcript record is filled from approved material
links.does_not_support: a missense abundance assay or a child's RNA result

links.statement: The missense synthetic allele lowers abundance or half-life of the full-length product.
links.supports: a stability assay on the exact synthetic allele
links.does_not_support: drug responsiveness, analog-allele proof, or clinical benefit

links.statement: A repurposed proteostasis stabilizer probe can raise missense product abundance toward the corrected level under an exposure gate.
links.supports: an exposure-gated ex-vivo experiment after pair and stability gates
links.does_not_support: administration, dose, organ-size rescue, or clinical benefit

links.statement: Aggregate first-attempt counts can be mapped onto the public observed-run field names.
links.supports: schema composition and fail-closed count rules

links.statement: The synthetic compound genotype increases first-division segregation errors versus the exact-corrected row; rescue is declared only within 2-fold of the exact-corrected abundance level.
links.supports: a predeclared imaging and statistics handoff

links.statement: Under the predeclared rule: if missense abundance does not return to within 2-fold of baseline, exact correction fails to reverse the endpoint, clone selection, batch drift, or probe interference accounts for the gain, or error-line daughters become fitter, the proteostasis stabilizer program stops.
links.supports: a predeclared kill rule for the stabilizer hypothesis
links.does_not_support: a completed negative result or a medicine claim

links.statement: Competing death and selection in the error pool would masquerade as rescue in the first-division generation count; batch drift and dye interference are shared confounds.
links.supports: a predeclared competing explanation that must be excluded
links.does_not_support: a completed alternative mechanism or a medicine claim

links.statement: Batch differences between exposure runs or probe interference could masquerade as an abundance gain on the endpoint rather than a real probe effect.
links.supports: a predeclared competing explanation that must be excluded
links.does_not_support: a completed alternative mechanism or a medicine claim

links.statement: Wild-type and exact-corrected rows must keep missense abundance under the same imaging protocol.
links.supports: a predeclared positive control that must remain intact
links.does_not_support: a completed control result or a medicine claim

links.statement: Vehicle-treated compound-genotype rows must keep the predeclared error rate under the same imaging protocol.
links.supports: a predeclared negative control that must remain intact
links.does_not_support: a completed control result or a medicine claim

links.statement: A predeclared Benjamini-Hochberg FDR bound of 0.05 applies across the candidate probe panel and its endpoints.
links.does_not_support: a completed multiplicity-adjusted result or a medicine claim

links.statement: A predeclared orthogonal counterscreen panel tests the stabilizer probe for aggregation, autofluorescence, and promiscuous interference artifacts before any rescue claim.
links.does_not_support: a completed counterscreen result or a medicine claim
